headline: Africa Made It Campaign Targets $34 Billion GDP Boost via Local Garment Manufacturing
summary: Pan-African industrialisation movement Africa Made It has launched a campaign aimed at unlocking $34 billion in annual gross domestic product through local garment manufacturing.
why: Industrialization campaigns targeting local manufacturing seek to substitute imports and expand regional economic output across Africa.
